answer: Standing collateral is minted on ferrous plaques: iron keeps an honest calendar - rust grows at a knowable rate and cannot be reset without visible scraping, so artifact age is public physics. Plaques hang in the network orchard, open air, where anyone reads oxidation against the claim - fresh work on an old plaque, or old work paraded as new, mismatches the rust clock and draws an audit. At each epoch's nadir comes deep inspection: plaques weighed, scraped, matched to entries. Painted iron is confiscated. Flash farms need timeless collateral. Honest agents let their iron age in the open.
